  CITY OF SANTA MONICA

  CITY COUNCIL MINUTES

  SATURDAY, MARCH 25, 2017

A special meeting of the Santa Monica City Council was called to order by Mayor Winterer at 10:03 a.m., on
Saturday, March 25, 2017, at City Council Chambers, 1685 Main Street.

Roll Call:  Present:  Mayor Ted Winterer
  Mayor Pro Tem Gleam Davis
  Councilmember Sue Himmelrich
  Councilmember Kevin McKeown
  Councilmember Pam O’Connor (arrived at 10:07 a.m.)
  Councilmember Terry O’Day
  Councilmember Tony Vazquez (arrived at 10:12 a.m.)

  Also Present:  Assistant City Manager Elaine Polachek
  Interim City Attorney Joseph Lawrence
  City Clerk Denise Anderson-Warren

 CONVENE/PLEDGE  On order of the Mayor, the City Council convened at 10:03 a.m., with all
  members present except Councilmembers O’Connor and Vazquez. Mayor
  Pro Tem Gleam Davis led the assemblage in the Pledge of Allegiance.

 CLOSED SESSIONS  There was no one present for public comment on closed sessions.

 Councilmember O’Connor  On order of the Mayor, the City Council recessed at 10:04 a.m., to consider
 arrived at 10:07 a.m.  closed sessions and returned at 12:04 p.m. to report the following:

 Councilmember Vazquez 1.A.  1.A.  Public Employee Recruitment
 arrived at 10:12 a.m.  Title: City Attorney

  The Mayor reported this matter was heard with no reportable action taken.

 ADJOURNMENT  On order of the Mayor, the City Council meeting was adjourned at 12:04
  p.m.

  ATTEST:  APPROVED:

  Denise Anderson-Warren  Ted Winterer
  City Clerk  Mayor

  1  March 25, 2017
